interpretationFindings.finding: The pinned ledger records ten matching groups and five unresolved flags: 54 ਕ੍ਰੂਰ/ਕਰੂਰ, 55 and 56 internal punctuation/grouping, 59 ਸਿਧਦਾ/ਸਿਧਿਦਾ, ਬੁਧਦਾ/ਬੁਧਿਦਾ and ਬ੍ਰਿਧ/ਬ੍ਰਿਧਿ, and 60 ਸਿੱਧ/ਸਿਧਿ. The last two affect grammatical or lexical analysis and are not dismissed as settled spelling variants. All flags and the global 67-group caveat remain.

Each of these seven units has two frozen source records. A longer record can contain several epithets. Explain each meaningful clause without splitting or renumbering the original records, adding a metrical heading, or inflating line coverage.

The paired descriptions of bodily form, independence and dissolution need separate attention. ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ has destruction and churning interpretations. Neither bodily language nor Divine power establishes a hierarchy among human bodies or permission for human cruelty.

ਨਮੋ ਭਾਨ ਭਾਨੇ is byte-identical at 46.03 and 47.02. Main bilingual explanations should agree; surrounding lunar and musical imagery may receive different contextual notes. Sun imagery is devotional praise, not an astronomical claim.

ਮਾਨ ਮਾਨੇ recurs with a final chhand number at 46.04 and without one at 56.02. Keep the chosen honour-related sense consistent while preserving the distinct source hashes. The paired phrase should not become a claim about every person consciously granting honour.

Moon, sun, song and ਤਾਨ form a sequence of intensified praise. A musical reading of ਤਾਨ is supported, while the derivative commentary also gives power/instrument language. Keep those alternatives distinct rather than turning all four epithets into generic greatness.

The movement through dance, sound, ਪਾਨ and ਬਾਦ is not reducible to four identical musical terms. Hand-related strength is a supported reading of ਪਾਨ; the poetic drum-beating rendering remains an alternative. Preserve ਨ੍ਰਿੱਤ and ਪਾਨ exactly rather than normalizing them from another witness.

Formlessness and namelessness are placed beside all forms, dissolution and ਬਿਭੂਤੇ, with abundance or manifested splendour among its readings. Explain the juxtaposition without pretending a physical shape or one word exhausts the Divine.

The first record intensifies absence of stain or blame; the second combines sovereignty with supreme being or splendour. ਨੇਕਲੰਕੀ in this passage is not silently converted into identification with a particular incarnation, complexion or social rank.

Both long records contain more than one quality: mastery of yoga with supreme attainment, and sovereignty with eminent greatness. ਬ੍ਰਿਧੇ is not reduced to bodily old age. Traditional siddha vocabulary describes the address, not a guaranteed skill acquired by recitation.

Weapons and projected weapons are followed by supreme knowledge and the world-mother image. Historical ਸਸਤ੍ਰ is broad enough to include projected subclasses. The passage does not authorize cruelty, establish male/female superiority, or turn maternal address into a biological claim.

All four opening epithets need coverage: guise, delusion, enjoyment/consumption and being enjoyed/consumed. The second record adds mastery of yoga and supreme union or skill. These terms do not label ordinary enjoyment or a person’s body as intrinsically impure.

The eternal sustaining address stands beside severe or fearsome action. The ਪ੍ਰੇਤ/ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ pair has departed/living, spirit-related and inanimate/conscious readings; ਦੇਵੇ and ਸੁਧਰਮੇ must also be explained. Preserve the selected reading and alternatives without diagnosing spirits or justifying cruelty as Divine permission.

Illness-removal language is followed by ਰਾਗ, with love and bliss among the commentary readings, then two sovereignty titles. ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹੰ is a royal expression here, not breathing instruction. Devotional illness language must not become a guaranteed medical cure or blame assigned to an ill person.

Giving and honour precede the paradox ਰੋਗ ਰੋਗੇ and the cleansing-related ਸਨਾਨੇ. Commentaries differ between affliction overcome and the power underlying affliction, and between purity and health-related paraphrase. These are theological interpretations, not clinical outcomes or instructions to replace care with bathing or recitation.

ਮੰਤ੍ਰ, ਜੰਤ੍ਰ, ਇਸਟ and ਤੰਤ੍ਰ name distinct devotional or ritual concepts. Preserve their differences and the repeated intensification. Explaining historical formula, diagram, beloved/worshipful focus or ritual-system vocabulary neither teaches a procedure nor guarantees magical results.

The received commentary unpacks ਸੱਚਦਾਨੰਦ through truth/being, consciousness and bliss while the same record names universal dissolution. The next record adds incomparability, formlessness and indwelling. Retain all these clauses and the frozen ਸਮਸਤੁਲ spelling; bliss is not a demand for constant human happiness.

The first record includes attainment, understanding and growth; the short-vowel ledger differences remain open. The selected second-line reading includes below, above and between, plus accumulated wrongdoing and its removal. The Vidhia-hosted commentary instead relates the descriptors to classes of wrongdoing. Keep that distinction explicit rather than dropping words or merging the readings.

The opening combines transcendent supremacy with hidden or unseen nurture, and the ending combines enduring gift-giving with compassion. Preserve the unresolved ਸਿੱਧ/ਸਿਧਿ contrast and distinguish accomplishment from extraordinary-power traditions. Neither hidden care nor siddhi vocabulary guarantees that a reader’s wishes will be fulfilled.

contentFindings: All paired epithets and longer multi-clause lines retain separate explanatory coverage. The seven two-line units preserve the frozen grouping and do not inflate the line count.
The sun and honour phrases have identical main bilingual wording at both occurrences; distinct source hashes remain where numbering differs.

Destruction/dissolution and churning alternatives remain distinct. The generic dissolution explanation at 49.03 follows Neki; Sant Sewa Singh’s directed destruction of offenders/adversaries is recorded separately.

The musical and hand-related readings at 47–48, broad/projected weapons and world-mother sequence at 52, four opening limits at 53, and departed/living pair plus noble dharam at 54 retain substantive lexical alternatives.

Illness and cleansing language at 55–56 is devotional interpretation without a cure guarantee, blame for illness, caste/body ranking or instruction to replace care. The royal title ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹੰ is not treated as breathing advice.
Mantra, yantra, isht and tantra remain distinct at 57 without ritual procedures or promised effects. Truth/being, awareness, bliss and universal dissolution all remain visible at 58.

The spatial sequence and accumulated-wrongdoing reading at 59 remains distinct from the Vidhia-hosted classes-of-wrongdoing alternative. The hidden-nurture and gift-giving clauses at 60 remain visible; siddh/sidhi morphology is not adjudicated.
No qualified review, source-edition clearance, canonical translation approval or public release approval is claimed. Anand24 teaching remains absent because disputed source line03 is still held.
